meaning.en: To hate someone or something so bitterly that one grinds one's teeth.
meaning.zh: 恨得咬牙切齿，形容痛恨到极点。

examples.zh: 村民对欺压他们的恶霸切齿痛恨。
examples.en: The villagers loathed the bully who oppressed them with gritted teeth.

examples.zh: 提起那次背叛，他仍然切齿痛恨。
examples.en: At the mention of that betrayal he still gnashes his teeth in hatred.

usage.en: Strong emotion, mainly of hatred; predicate or adverbial. 切 is qiè ('grind'), not qiē ('cut'). Compare 咬牙切齿 which stresses the physical gesture.
usage.zh: 情感强烈，多表示仇恨，作谓语或状语。“切”读qiè（磨、咬），不读qiē。与“咬牙切齿”相比，后者更强调动作。

meaning.en: To stroll aimlessly, letting one's feet take one wherever they will.
meaning.zh: 随意地走，没有一定的目的和方向。

examples.zh: 饭后他信步而行，不知不觉走到了江边。
examples.en: After dinner he strolled at random and found himself at the riverside.

examples.zh: 春日的清晨，两人在古镇里信步而行。
examples.en: On a spring morning the two strolled through the old town.

usage.en: A relaxed, literary description; 信 here means 'at will' (not 'believe'). Also 信步走去, 信步闲游.
usage.zh: 轻松的书面描写。“信”在此意为任意、随意，不是“相信”。

meaning.en: Reaching everywhere from heaven to earth; boundless in knowledge, ability or influence.
meaning.zh: 上通天，下彻地，形容本领极大，或见识、法力无边。

examples.zh: 神话里的大圣通天彻地，无所不能。
examples.en: In myth the Great Sage reaches heaven and earth and can do anything.

examples.zh: 他自称有通天彻地之能，其实不过是吹牛。
examples.en: He claimed to have all-reaching powers, but it was mere bragging.

usage.en: Often used of gods, immortals and awe-inspiring masters; can be ironic when a person boasts. 彻 is chè ('pierce through').
usage.zh: 常用于神仙、神通广大之人；有人自夸时可含讽刺。“彻”读chè（贯穿）。

meaning.en: Deeply affectionate and loyal; having strong feeling and a heavy sense of obligation.

equivalents: warm and loyal to the core

examples.zh: 两位老友情深义重，几十年来互相扶持。
examples.en: The two old friends are deeply devoted and have supported each other for decades.

examples.zh: 他对旧部下情深义重，从未忘记。
examples.en: He was loyal to his old subordinates and never forgot them.

usage.en: Praise for friends, couples and comrades; predicate or attributive. Compare 情深意长 (affection) vs 情深义重 (affection plus duty).
usage.zh: 赞美朋友、夫妻、战友之间的深情厚谊，作谓语或定语。“情深义重”包含责任感。

meaning.en: Swift as a meteor racing after the moon; describing very fast motion.
meaning.zh: 像流星追赶月亮一样，形容速度极快。

examples.zh: 他纵马狂奔，如流星赶月般冲出了重围。
examples.en: He galloped as swift as a meteor and broke out of the encirclement.

examples.zh: 快递小哥骑着电动车流星赶月，赶在零点前送到。
examples.en: The courier sped on his scooter like a meteor and delivered before midnight.

usage.en: Descriptive and vivid, popular in martial and vernacular fiction. Usually adverbial.
usage.zh: 生动的描写，常见于武侠和白话小说，多作状语。

meaning.en: So high in rank or fortune that it cannot be described; of a person destined for great eminence.
meaning.zh: 显贵到无法形容，指命相或地位极其尊贵。

examples.zh: 相士说他贵不可言，日后必有大富大贵。
examples.en: The fortune-teller said he was destined for the highest honours.

examples.zh: 她出身贵不可言，却从不摆架子。
examples.en: She is of exalted birth, yet never puts on airs.

usage.en: Used in fortune-telling and in historical fiction; today a hyperbolic compliment. Often 面相贵不可言. Do not confuse with 妙不可言 ('wonderful').
usage.zh: 多用于相命及历史小说，今日是夸张的恭维，常说“面相贵不可言”。不要与“妙不可言”混淆。

natural: famous and respected in one's day

meaning.en: To be highly esteemed and famous at a particular time.
meaning.zh: 在某一时期享有很高的声望。

examples.zh: 这位诗人当年名重一时，如今却少有人读。
examples.en: The poet was the toast of his day but is rarely read now.

examples.zh: 他在乾隆年间名重一时，求画者络绎不绝。
examples.en: In the Qianlong era he was highly esteemed and painting seekers came in a stream.

usage.en: Respectful; implies fame limited to an era. Often followed by a but-clause. Compare 名噪一时 which is more neutral about the reason for fame.
usage.zh: 带敬意，暗示名声只在一个时期。后面常有转折。与“名噪一时”相比，后者对出名原因更中性。

natural: vow to live and die together

meaning.en: To swear to share life and death, no matter what; a pledge of absolute loyalty.
meaning.zh: 发誓同生共死，表示忠诚不渝。

equivalents: swear to stand together till death

examples.zh: 三兄弟桃园结义，誓同生死。
examples.en: The three brothers swore at Peach Garden to live and die together.

examples.zh: 战友们誓同生死，没有一人后退。
examples.en: The comrades vowed to share life and death, and none stepped back.

usage.en: Heroic, loyal; associated with sworn brotherhood in Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Usually used in the past or in oaths.
usage.zh: 豪迈、忠诚，与《三国演义》桃园结义相关，多用于誓言或回顾。

meaning.en: Petty, vulgar townspeople, ruled by profit and gossip; a derogatory term for the lowbrow.
meaning.zh: 指城镇中庸俗、唯利是图的人，含轻蔑。

examples.zh: 他不愿与市井之徒为伍。
examples.en: He refused to keep company with petty marketplace types.

examples.zh: 在士大夫眼里，商人不过是市井之徒。
examples.en: In the eyes of the scholar-officials, merchants were mere marketplace riff-raff.

usage.en: Contemptuous, mostly historical; 市井 (market and well) means 'town' in general. Reflects an old class prejudice and can offend today.
usage.zh: 轻蔑，多见于历史语境。“市井”泛指城市。反映旧时阶层偏见，今天使用要谨慎。

meaning.en: Speaking haltingly in a low voice, as if afraid or unwilling to say it out loud.
meaning.zh: 想说又不敢说，吞吞吐吐、低声嘀咕的样子。

examples.zh: 他嗫嗫嚅嚅地说了半天，谁也没听清。
examples.en: He mumbled for ages and no one made out what he said.

examples.zh: 被老师问到，孩子嗫嗫嚅嚅，不敢抬头。
examples.en: Asked by the teacher, the child mumbled and dared not look up.

usage.en: Describes a timid or embarrassed way of speaking. Pronounce 嗫 as niè and 嚅 as rú. Usually adverbial with 地.
usage.zh: 形容胆怯或尴尬时说话的样子。“嗫”读niè，“嚅”读rú。多作状语，后加“地”。

meaning.en: To blow out clouds and mist; originally of dragons and spirits, now of heavy smokers or steam-belching machines.
meaning.zh: 喷出云雾，原指龙、神怪呼云唤雾，也形容吸烟人吐烟、机器喷出蒸汽的样子。

examples.zh: 火车头喷云吐雾，缓缓驶出站台。
examples.en: The locomotive belched clouds of steam and pulled slowly out of the platform.

examples.zh: 他坐在门口喷云吐雾，一根接一根。
examples.en: He sat in the doorway puffing out clouds of smoke, one after another.

usage.en: A vivid, somewhat humorous way to describe smoking or steaming. Compare 吞云吐雾 (also smoking, or opium smoking, more common).
usage.zh: 生动，略带诙谐，形容吸烟或喷出蒸汽。与“吞云吐雾”相近，后者更常见。

natural: a thousand autumns, ten thousand years

meaning.en: Many, many years; a wish for a very long life, or a long-lasting reign, state or work.
meaning.zh: 指很多很多年，是祝寿、祝颂国家或事业长久的话。

equivalents: may you live a thousand years

examples.zh: 祝君千秋万岁，福寿安康。
examples.en: May you live a thousand autumns, in good fortune and health.

examples.zh: 他们的友谊千秋万岁，永不改变。
examples.en: Their friendship will last for ten thousand years and never change.

usage.en: A grand wish, traditionally to emperors; used lightly now for birthdays or anniversaries. Compare 万寿无疆. Also used to mean 'after death' (百年之后).
usage.zh: 宏大的祝辞，古时用于祝皇帝；今天用于生日、纪念时较轻松。可比较“万寿无疆”。

meaning.en: A narrow-minded, mean-spirited townsperson, interested in petty gain and gossip.
meaning.zh: 城镇中目光短浅、自私计较的人。

examples.zh: 他是个市井小人，只会斤斤计较。
examples.en: He is a petty townsman who only knows how to haggle.

examples.zh: 不要跟市井小人一般见识。
examples.en: Don't stoop to the level of a petty-minded person.

usage.en: Derogatory, a little classist; used in the same way as 市井之徒 but stressing meanness and pettiness. Often 小人 alone is used.
usage.zh: 贬义，略含阶层偏见，用法类似“市井之徒”，但更强调自私琐碎。

meaning.en: Speaking or singing slowly, clearly and with each word accurately measured; each word in place.
meaning.zh: 说话或唱戏时每个字都清楚、有节奏、有分寸。

examples.zh: 老艺人唱戏一字一板，听得清清楚楚。
examples.en: The old performer sang each word on its beat, and it was perfectly clear.

examples.zh: 他一字一板地念出判决书。
examples.en: He read out the verdict word by word, with every beat clear.

usage.en: Describes diction or deliberate speech. From opera, where 板 is the beat of the wooden clapper. Compare 一板一眼 (strict, rule-bound), which is wider.
usage.zh: 描写吐字清晰、说话认真。源于戏曲，“板”指板眼节拍。比较“一板一眼”，后者范围更广，也指做事刻板。
